question: In which state is Mormugao Port located?
solution:
The correct answer is __Goa.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mormugao Port is located in the state of Goa, which is one of the smallest states in India.
 
• It is the leading iron ore exporting port of India and handles other types of cargo as well, such as coal, petroleum products, and fertilizers.
 
• The port is situated on the southern side of the Zuari River, which flows into the Arabian Sea.
 
• Mormugao Port is an important economic hub for the state of Goa and plays a crucial role in the state's trade and commerce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tamil Nadu is a southern state of India and has major ports like Chennai Port, Kamarajar Port, and VO Chidambaranar Port.
 
• West Bengal is an eastern state of India and has major ports like Kolkata Port and Haldia Port.
 
• Maharashtra is a western state of India and has major ports like Mumbai Port, Jawaharlal Nehru Port.
